text:
Mei Chen: Hi @people-ops — I just submitted my resignation; last day will be 2026-04-15. What are the steps for benefits, final pay, and access?
People Ops Bot: Thanks Mei. A People Ops rep will DM you within 1 business day. Please confirm your personal email for COBRA paperwork.
Mei Chen: personal is mei.chen+personal@gmail.com
Ash Patel: @Mei Chen thanks for the heads up — Ash (eng manager). We'll coordinate the handover. Can you list which repos/services you still need access to through 4/15?
Mei Chen: infra-ops, model-serving, and shared-embeddings. I only need them until 2026-04-10 though.
Dana Ortiz: Hi Mei — Dana from People Ops. Quick answers: 
- Benefits: company medical continues until 2026-04-30 (end of month).
- COBRA: election window opens after termination; you have 60 days from the COBRA notice date.
- Final paycheck: processed on next scheduled payroll after 4/15, includes PTO proration.
- 401(k): Fidelity handles distributions; we'll send plan contact info.
Mei Chen: OK, thanks. Will I get COBRA paperwork mailed or emailed?
Dana Ortiz: We'll email the initial COBRA packet to mei.chen+personal@gmail.com and also upload to the employee portal.
Ash Patel: IT note: can we keep her SSO until 4/16 09:00 PT to wrap up handoffs? After that remove access.
IT Oncall: Please submit offboard ticket. Use quick command:```/offboard create --user mei.chen --last-day 2026-04-15 --assets laptop,hotspot --remove-after 2026-04-16```
Ash Patel: Ticket created: OFF-3421. Laptop pickup scheduled 2026-04-18 (courier).
IT Oncall: Confirmed. We'll remove IAM roles for infra-ops and model-serving on 2026-04-16 09:00 PT, disable SSO same time, keep email forwarding until 2026-04-30.
Mei Chen: Appreciate that timeline. One more: will my healthcare charges be pro-rated for April?
Dana Ortiz: No pro-rate — employer coverage runs through 4/30. Any premiums already deducted will be reconciled on final paycheck if needed.
Mei Chen: Got it. Also want to schedule exit interview week of 4/6.
People Ops Bot: Exit interview poll sent. Current slot: 2026-04-12 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).
Mei Chen: Confirmed.
Ash Patel: Also flagged sensitive creds in 2 repos — Mei, please push any last cleanup or short revoke notes before 4/10 EOD.
Mei Chen: Will do. I'll add a README note in infra-ops and create a small handover doc in /docs/offboard-mei.
Dana Ortiz: Uploading the official offboarding checklist to Confluence and DMing the COBRA/401k forms. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/xxx/offboard-checklist (internal). :thumbsup:
Mei Chen: Perfect, thanks everyone.
People Ops Bot: Ticket OFF-3421 updated: assets/laptop pickup scheduled; COBRA packet queued.
IT Oncall: Once IAM removal completes we'll post a thread update.
Mei Chen: Thanks — feeling much better having the timeline.
